name: house-tee-black-front
_comment_printArea: Corners of the printable panel on the BLANK, in blank pixels, clockwise from top-left. See README for how to read these off a photo. Artwork is stretched to fill the quad, so keep its aspect ratio close to the quad's or it will distort.
_comment_displacement: Grayscale map derived from this blank's own shading. strength is pixels of push at full black/white — 4-10 reads as cloth.
_comment_blend: The pipeline default is multiply at 0.85, which is right for dark ink on a LIGHT garment. This is a black tee with red ink — ink lighter than the cloth — so multiply would crush it to mud. 'over' keeps the ink's own colour and the fold realism comes from shading below.
_comment_shading: Folds brighten/darken the ink, pivoting on the garment's mean luminance under the print. This is what sells it as printed rather than pasted, on any garment colour.
_comment_fabricTexture: Weave lifted from the blank's own high-frequency detail (no tiling, no seams) and laid back over the print, clipped to the garment.
